case_title.quote: Karakkattu Muhammed Basheer v. The State of Kerala
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption exactly.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused are identified and tried in the judgment.

accused_gender.quote: carried the dead body ... on his shoulder
accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to as male throughout ('his shoulder', 'he').

accused_age.reason: The judgment nowhere states the accused's age; the value 28 has no basis in the text.

accused_religion.reason: No religion of the accused is mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: No caste of the accused is mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: The appellant's occupation is not stated; the taxi driver mentioned is a witness, not the accused.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not discussed in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record of the accused is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the body of a woman was discovered in a paddy field
victim_gender.reason: The victim Gouri is described as a woman and referred to as 'she'.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not given anywhere in the judgment; 28 is unsupported.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Victim's religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Married on paper (registered marriage 17.05.1989, dissolved 31.07.1989); victim was related to Accused No. 02
accused_victim_relationship.quote: the Appellant ... entered into a registered marriage with Gouri on 17.05.1989
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The appellant was in a registered marriage with the victim, not a stranger, though the marriage was dissolved in July 1989.

offence_category.quote: for the murder of one Gouri during the night of 16th-17th August 1989
offence_category.reason: The offence charged and discussed is murder under section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.302, 201 (charged with ss.302, 201 read with s.34; s.34 charge not established)
statutory_provisions.quote: charged under Section 302, 201 read with Section 34 of IPC, but they were acquitted of the charge of Section 34
statutory_provisions.reason: Section 34 was charged but the accused was acquitted of it; convictions were under ss.302 and 201 only.

weapon.quote: grabbed a coconut scrapper from the kitchen and hit Gouri on the head multiple times
weapon.reason: The coconut scrapper is identified as the weapon used for the killing.

evidence_type.quote: the case of the prosecution is solely based upon circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Case is circumstantial; postmortem medical evidence and recoveries are also relied on.

confession.quote: there is no eyewitness of the incident in question, and therefore, the case of the prosecution is solely based upon circumstantial evidence
confession.reason: No confession is mentioned; the case rests solely on circumstantial evidence.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not discuss any aggravating circumstances.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: The judgment does not discuss any mitigating circumstances.

trial_court_outcome.quote: upholding the order of conviction and sentence passed by the Sessions Court
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Court convicted the appellant under ss.302 and 201 and sentenced him.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld
high_court_outcome.quote: These appeals came to be dismissed by the impugned judgment, upholding the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court did not return 'not applicable'; it dismissed the appeals and upheld conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all the charges.
final_outcome.reason: The Supreme Court allowed the appeal and acquitted the appellant.

offence_finally_established.quote: The case having not been proved what to say of beyond reasonable doubt against the Appellant
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established against the appellant after acquittal.

imprisonment_type.quote: The Appellant be set free forthwith.
imprisonment_type.reason: Final outcome is acquittal, so no imprisonment type applies.

imprisonment_years.quote: The Appellant be set free forthwith.
imprisonment_years.reason: No imprisonment remains after acquittal, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The prosecution alleged that the accused, with another accused, murdered a woman at the latter's house at night. Her body was found in a paddy field. The prosecution alleged an illicit relationship motive, a coconut scrapper attack, dragging of the body, and recovery of blood-stained items and the weapon.
neutral_facts.quote: However, the evidence was criticized for gaps and inconsistencies
neutral_facts.reason: The 'criticized for gaps' sentence signals the court's assessment and hints at the acquittal outcome; neutral facts should omit it.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment under s.302 (as sentenced by lower courts); no minimum term stated
offence_severity.quote: The sentence included life imprisonment under Section 302
offence_severity.reason: Life imprisonment is supported, but a 10-year minimum is not stated anywhere in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: for the murder of one Gouri
attempt_completion.reason: The murder was completed, the victim having died from head injuries.

physical_harm.quote: six antemortem injuries on the left side of the head fractured into multiple fragments, as well as abraded contusions on the right wrist and left knee
physical_harm.reason: Injuries and their sufficiency to cause death are accurately described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged with ss.302 and 201 (r/w s.34); no charge upheld, appellant acquitted of all charges
number_of_offences.quote: The Appellant is acquitted of all the charges.
number_of_offences.reason: Nothing was finally upheld against the appellant; he was acquitted of all charges, so 'one upheld' is wrong.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is discussed in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.quote: An altercation occurred between the Appellant and the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning is stated; the prosecution case describes an altercation.

motive.quote: there was illicit relationship between the Appellant and Accused No. 02
motive.reason: The prosecution's asserted motive was the illicit relationship between the two accused.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: None accepted; the Court found the presence, bag recovery, and blood-stain/weapon recoveries unreliable and not relied upon
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the prosecution has failed in its endeavour of bringing home the guilt against the Appellant
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court did not accept the prosecution's circumstantial case; it rejected the evidence and acquitted.

witness_credibility.quote: this witness acknowledges that he assumed that the person he had seen on the date of incident entering the house of Accused No. 02 was the Appellant
witness_credibility.reason: Court doubted PW14 (back view, assumed identity) and PW20 (distant sighting), and PW18's recovery account.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Prosecution alleged appellant disposed of body, returned to Accused No. 02's house, and left town next morning (PW20); court did not accept this
post_offence_conduct.quote: He then came back to the house of Accused No. 2 and left for his destination the following morning.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Alleged post-offence conduct is described in the judgment, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Custody duration is not stated in the judgment.

bail_history.quote: In case the Appellant has been released on bail, the bail bonds and the sureties, if any, are hereby discharged.
bail_history.reason: Bail history is only mentioned conditionally, with no actual bail details stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 16-17 Aug 1989; High Court judgment 18.10.1996; Supreme Court decision 05.11.2024; Sessions Court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 18.10.1996 of the High Court of Kerala
trial_duration.reason: 18.10.1996 is the High Court judgment date; the trial court's judgment date is not stated.

legal_representation.quote: Thomas P. Joseph, Sr. Adv., Dr. Linto K.B., Tom Joseph, Dinny Thomas, Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Appearances for appellant and respondent are accurately listed.

investigation_status.quote: registered a case of unnatural death at the Parappanangadi Police Station
investigation_status.reason: A case was registered, a final report was filed, and trial was completed.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Recoveries not made in presence of independent witnesses; PW18 account of bag handover discrepant; planting not ruled out
procedural_irregularity.quote: those being made not in the presence of independent witnesses
procedural_irregularity.reason: The Court flagged recovery irregularities, lack of independent witnesses and possible planting, so 'None noted' is wrong.

appeal_history.correct_value: Sessions Court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: appeals dismissed, conviction upheld; Supreme Court: appeal allowed, acquitted
appeal_history.quote: upholding the order of conviction and sentence passed by the Sessions Court
appeal_history.reason: Sessions Court convicted; it did not uphold a conviction. The High Court and Supreme Court entries are correct.

prosecution_argument.quote: the prosecution sought to establish motive for the murder by asserting that there was illicit relationship
prosecution_argument.reason: Summarizes the prosecution's motive, presence, and recovery-based case accurately.

defence_argument.quote: the case is solely based upon circumstantial evidence, with no eyewitness to the occurrence
defence_argument.reason: Accurately reflects the defence submissions on circumstantial evidence and gaps.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the prosecution must establish all the pieces of incriminating circumstances by reliable and clinching evidence
legal_principle_applied.reason: Panchsheel principles and the beyond-reasonable-doubt standard are correctly described.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Ramreddy Rajesh Khanna Reddy and Another v. State of A.P. [2006] 3 SCR 348 : (2006) 10 SCC 172
precedent_relied_upon.reason: The precedent cited is the case relied on for the panchsheel principles.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing rationale is given because the appellant was acquitted.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment discusses no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment discusses no aggravating factors.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Appellant's bail bonds and sureties discharged and appellant set free; co-accused (Accused No. 02) sentenced to four years under s.201
other_sentence_order.quote: The Appellant be set free forthwith.
other_sentence_order.reason: Omits the release and bail-discharge order for the appellant and the co-accused's four-year sentence.
